title: One level after another
lead: Every level is one fire. Put it out and the next level opens. The fires slowly get harder, and the levels never run out.
pathMore: And so on. There is always a next level.

how.title: How you get points
how.lead: Every fire counts: the campaign, the daily fire and quick fires. You never lose points.
how.fire: Each fire you put out, more for a bigger board
how.noHints: Solved without a hint (daily fire and campaign)
how.streak: Playing the daily fire several days in a row
